title: QA run · platform-core (27/34) · 5b14b7f3 · 2026-10-19 · 21 PASS / 4 PARTIAL / 2 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 7 NOT-RUN
body:
QA run record for selector `area:platform-core` (bare area `platform-core` in the title for the roll-up), 18.0 release sweep, plan B (Tier 1 + Tier 2 driven, Tier 3 deferred). Text only — no screenshots; reproduction rules below.

## Environment fingerprint

- framework: `5b14b7f3ad8e2e0786d228772f473d07b36b2477` (objectstack-ai/objectstack, pinned — no pull)
- console: vendored objectui build stamped `4016370af3c9c9dafec2bc5299afd8e8079701b8` (= `.objectui-sha`), built with `pnpm objectui:build`; objectui-only pins run in a checkout at that same sha
- app: examples/app-showcase, canonical boot `OS_PORT=P objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p P -d file:RUN/data.db` with per-item OS_HOME / OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT; package-installing items booted from a scratch copy outside the repo
- ports: each runner its own range (41100–42319), one file DB per item; seed: stock showcase (132 rows) + `--seed-admin`
- run window: 2026-10-19 12:26–13:45 UTC; host: 4 vCPU / 15 GB container shared by up to 7 parallel runners (load average peaked ~40; two boots timed out under load and were re-run serially — no verdict rests on a starved run)
- runner: one dispatching session + parallel runner sub-agents (not sequential); every persona identity proven server-side (`GET /auth/get-session`) before each cell

## Scope

Selector `area:platform-core` → 34 runnable items (`node scripts/checklist-select.mjs area:platform-core --json`). No planned items; none hidden as blocked. The 4 unpinned P0 items (boot-health, seed-integrity, console-login, builtin-apps-nav-render) are also driven by the separate `priority:P0` gate card — independent second judgement by design.

## Reproduction rules for each FAIL

### `platform-core.package-lifecycle-enable-disable` · acceptance[5] — product defect (objectui console)

Clause: after disable, the package's nav is gone and a stale deep link lands on a named not-found inside the shell, never a dead page. Nav-absent half passes; the deep-link half fails. Reproduced 2/2 by the first runner and 2/2 by an independent RUNNER rule 7 verifier on a fresh boot (traps ruled out: 60 s settle with silent network after 1.1 s; console stamp = pin; direct navigation, no clicks on the failing surface).

1. Boot showcase (`objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin`); `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email {"email":"admin@objectos.ai","password":"admin123"}` → bearer.
2. `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.probe","name":"QA Probe","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"qaprobe"}}` → 201.
3. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qaprobe_widget?mode=draft&package=com.qa.probe {"name":"qaprobe_widget","label":"QA Widget","sharingModel":"public_read_write","fields":{"name":{"type":"text"}}}` → 200; `POST /api/v1/packages/com.qa.probe/publish-drafts {}` → 200; `GET /api/v1/meta/object/qaprobe_widget` → 200.
4. `PATCH /api/v1/packages/com.qa.probe/disable {}` → 200 `status:disabled`. `GET /api/v1/meta/object/qaprobe_widget` → 404 `{"error":"Object 'qaprobe_widget' belongs to a disabled package…","code":"OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED"}`.
5. Sign in through `/_console/login`, open `/_console/apps/showcase_app/qaprobe_widget`.
   - expected: Showcase shell with a named not-found / package-disabled state.
   - actual: full-page "ObjectOS · Opening your console…" splash, still present at 60 s; network shows two 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`, then nothing.
   - control: `/_console/apps/showcase_app/no_such_object_xyz` → 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` → named "Object Not Found" inside the shell.

Discriminator (verifier, Playwright response rewrite, status kept 404): wrapped body with the SAME code still hangs; flat or wrapped body with code `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` renders the named not-found. The code value decides, not the envelope. Mechanism (objectui at the pin and on objectui main 61ed5ada alike): `isMetaItemAbsentError` (data-objectstack) recognises only `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, so the by-name scope read is classed failed; `fetchScopeName` drops it without re-render; the first-paint gate in `AppContent.tsx` never settles. Secondary framework observation (not the cause): the RestServer `/meta/object/:name` refusal is the flat `{error, code}` shape without the `object` key `/data` carries, while the runtime dispatcher answers the wrapped envelope — both are live ADR-0112 shapes; the #7557 changelog example shows only the wrapped one.

### `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` · acceptance[2] — assertion defect (not a product break)

Clause: "the refused boot did not alter the database", oracle `build`, checksum before == after.

1. Build a real v17 database: npm `@objectstack/cli@17.7.0`, `os init`, `os dev --seed-admin -d file:v17.db`, create 3 records, stop (sha256 `de915b8f…`, 69 tables, 66 rows).
2. Copy it; from examples/app-showcase run `OS_DATABASE_URL=file:COPY OS_SECRET_KEY=64-hex objectstack serve -p PORT`.
3. Result 3/3: rc=1 before listening, refusal names the 7 tables still carrying `organization_id` and `os migrate organization-ownership` (acceptance[1] pass). sha256 after `ba74b704…` ≠ before — expected by the clause: equal.
4. Row-level diff (pristine vs after, each table on its original columns): 0 tables differ, 66/66 rows identical, no new table holds a row, no column dropped. The change is the engine's additive schema sync (41 empty tables, `__search` columns, indexes). A 17.7.0 boot of the refused copy still serves the 3 original rows.

§5 disposition: **assertion defect**. The declared contract is row-level: runtime CHANGELOG ("judges … after the engine's schema sync (the column the rewrite step waits for is still added) … A refused boot leaves every row as it found it"), the guard's header, and the kernel pin that asserts the additive tables exist and hold no rows. negative[0] (served or half-migrated v17 DB) holds. Owed: re-point acceptance[2] to a row-level oracle (routed to the wave anchor, see below). acceptance[3] is blocked(fixture): the step's `services:{auth:false}` is not a real stack key.
